messages:
tony: Quick question  Im leaving the company next month and HR said Ill get COBRA info. How long after my last day will COBRA paperwork arrive? Also can I keep the same plan and will claims incurred after termination be covered if I elect COBRA? Any subsidy options?
Rina (People Ops): Hi @tony  short: carrier/COBRA vendor usually mails/email the COBRA packet within 14 days of the employer notifying them (we notify same day as payroll termination). You have 60 days from the date of the COBRA election notice (or from loss of coverage) to elect. If you elect and pay premiums retroactively, coverage is typically retroactive to your termination date so claims in that window are covered.
Benefits Bot: COBRA FAQs: https://benefits.redwoodinc/cobra-faq. Typical timeline: termination processed -> vendor sends notice (within 14 days) -> 60-day election window -> 45 days to pay initial premium after election (varies).
tony: If Im hired elsewhere quickly, can I cancel COBRA and get a refund for premiums paid?
Rina (People Ops): Yes, you can cancel COBRA if you get other coverage. Refund policy depends on the COBRA vendor/carrier. Often premiums are refunded pro-rata, but sometimes carriers keep admin fees. Keep records and if you want we can file for a refund when you provide new coverage start date.
marta: FYI I did COBRA for 2 weeks while starting a new job; carrier charged the full month then refunded part after I provided proof of new coverage. Took ~3 payroll cycles to show as refund.
Rina (People Ops): Last note: employer cannot subsidize COBRA premiums except under specific severance agreements. If you have a separation package that mentions subsidy, send it to benefits@redwood.com and well set it up. Otherwise COBRA is employee-paid at full cost (employer share + employee share + 2% admin).
tony: Great  thanks. How do I actually pay premiums if I elect? Online or check?
Rina (People Ops): The COBRA packet will include payment options: online portal, check, or card. Initial premium often must be received within 45 days of election for continuous coverage back to termination. After that, monthly payments are due per vendor schedule. Well also include contact info for vendor if anything goes sideways.
Benefits Bot: Vendor contact: cobra.vendor@thirdparty.com. Reminder: electing COBRA keeps your same plan, providers, and member ID (but physical card may change).
